name: Almoosa Health Company
summary: Almoosa Health Company operates as a private healthcare provider in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It stores medical items and sells medicine, cosmetics, and disposable medical items. The company also operates specialist and rehabilitation hospitals, medical and emergency centers, pharmacies, mental health clinics, and oncology centers, as well as a college of health sciences.
